# Autoconnecto

> Autoconnecto is a multi-tenant IoT SaaS platform (India) for real-time device monitoring, remote control, alarms, and automation.

- Marketing site: https://www.autoconnecto.in
- Product overview: https://www.autoconnecto.in/product

## Pricing (INR) — Autoconnecto IoT platform

All prices in Indian Rupees. Billed monthly or yearly. See https://www.autoconnecto.in/plans.json for machine-readable data.

| Plan | Monthly INR | Yearly INR | Users | Dashboards | Devices | Retention | White-label |
|------|-------------|------------|-------|------------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| Free | 0 | 0 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 7 days | No |
| Hobby | 199 | 1999 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 15 days | No |
| Starter | 899 | 8999 | 3 | 5 | 10 | 60 days | No |
| Growth | 3499 | 34999 | 10 | 20 | 100 | 180 days | Yes |
| Enterprise | 19999 | 199999 | 25 | 50 | 500 | 365 days | Yes |

Free: evaluation and first live test. Hobby: makers and prototypes. Starter: small deployments. Growth: commercial SMB with white-label. Enterprise: large production with white-label.
